title: Acceptance probability of a three-literal clause
statement: Fix any three Boolean negation choices. A uniformly random Boolean assignment to the three variables satisfies the resulting disjunction of literals with probability $7/8$.
hypotheses_covered: The three negation choices are fixed elements of $\mathrm{Fin}(3)\to\mathrm{Bool}$
